title: Sprint checklist & evidence microtasks - Samir
content:
Quick morning brain dump - put this in the handoff doc later.

Top context: need to close out a few tiny evidence gaps before Friday audit dry-run. Not enough time for big automation; aim for repeatable manual steps and clear owners.

Morning priorities (start with 1,2):
- [ ] IAM snapshot for staging and prod (confirm service accounts + least-priv lists) — target: 2pm today. Ticket: JIRA-INF-1248, note to attach screenshots of roles pages.
- [ ] KMS key listing + rotation proof (Data buckets) — grab key history from KMS console and key policy JSON. If missing, ask infra for audit logs (infra-req-432).
- [ ] Vendor: DataVault Inc. interim review checklist — confirm SOC2 Type II report receipt, encryption-at-rest statement, subprocessor list. Quick score: FAIL/UNVERIFIED on subprocessor mapping.
- [ ] Vendor: SecureKey LLC — they returned an attestation, but need the signed date and scope (only dev env?). Chase legal to confirm scope.
- [ ] Evidence folder organization in GDrive (where reviewers will look): create structure: /evidence/2026-04-audit/{iam,kms,vendors,policies,env-configs}. I will stub it and put a README.txt with steps.

Notes / capture details:
- IAM: run `gcloud iam roles list` -> save as text. Capture UI screenshot for at least one service account used by Redwood Runtime. Note: include timestamp in filename (yyyy-mm-ddThhmm).
- KMS: export key metadata JSON via console/CLI. If rotation schedule missing, add a short note in evidence explaining last known manual rotation (from infra slack).
- Vendors: DataVault - email thread dated 2026-03-21 has missing subprocessor appendix; create a small escalation email to vendor-cust-success@datavault.com + cc legal.
- Policies: encryption policy draft v0.9 needs a single-line summary for the auditor. Add a bullet list of where encryption is enforced (db snapshots, batch logs, object storage).

Handoff blurb for whoever picks this up: 
- Goal: put enough primary-source screenshots and exported artifacts into the evidence folder so an external reviewer can verify controls without asking for more than 1 follow-up.
- If you find a missing artifact, annotate with why it is missing and who to ping.

Microtasks (can be parallelized):
1) Lina: capture prod service account role list + 2 screenshots (roles page + service account detail). Save under evidence/iam/prod-svcacct-YYYYMMDD.png.
2) Jordan: run KMS key export for bucket keys, save JSON and minimal README for where to find key policies in console.
3) Me (Samir): vendor follow-ups, short email drafts, attach vendor report PDFs into evidence/vendors.

Draft vendor email (to copy/paste):
Subject: Request - Subprocessor Appendix and Signed Attestation (Redwood SOC2 Prep)
Hi (Vendor contact),

We are preparing for an internal SOC2 dry-run and need your most recent subprocessor appendix and the signed attestation that covers production systems as of 2026-03-31. Could you send those documents or point us to a secure download? If scope excludes production, please confirm the exact boundaries.

Thanks,
Samir (Security, Redwood Inference)

Evidence naming conventions (quick reminder):
- Use lowercase, hyphens. prefix with audit date. example: 2026-04-06_iam_prod_svcacct-roles.png
- All exports include captured command or console path in a README next to file.

Unresolved / questions to doc:
- Do we need signed vendor contracts for all major vendors or only those with data access? (ask legal)
- Is the KMS rotation event logged centrally? Infra said yes but haven't seen central index.

Quick scratch calculations:
- Estimated time: IAM captures (0.5h), KMS exports (0.75h), vendor chase (0.5-1h), assembly (0.5h) -> ~3h total.

End-of-day wrap (template):
- What I completed: 
- What I couldn't finish and why:
- Hand-off notes and next steps:

Random notes to self: 
- Don't forget to add small note in Console Rollout ticket about possible permission explosion after role changes.
- Save copies of any support case IDs.

Copy of recent links to stash: 
- Confluence index (above) -> add direct link to the evidence folder once created.
- PR to update encryption policy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/879 (add link to evidence).

Timestamp: 2026-04-06 09:12 - quick checkpoint before standup.

---

This is a working list; will clean and move into the shared evidence folder once items are captured.

Notes to self (closing): prioritize vendors if legal asks, else finish KMS + IAM first.
